correctness.rationale: The determinant-one integer change of coordinates gives gcd(qk+r,pk+floor(pr/q))=gcd(k+Ur+Vt_r,s_r), where s_r runs bijectively through 1,..,q-1. Periods s_r divide L, so each full k-block contains exactly (L/s_r)phi(s_r/d) solutions. Class r=0 yields gcd=k and the indicator. Summing yields the exact formula and integrality. Fixed-d densities follow from uniform full blocks; total mass uses sum_{e|s}phi(e)=s. The q->infinity limit uses elementary Möbius inversion with an O(log M) error. Exact rational/integer checker passed finite cases but does not stand in for this proof.

originality.rationale: The complete numerator-independent gcd distribution, exact blockwise counts for every d, escaping 1/q mass and q-to-infinity interpolation are not implied by the closest inspected theorems. Holdridge requires irrational equidistribution; Sykora treats p=1,d=1 only; Srichan uses independently indexed floor values. OEIS A250031 tabulates the covered p=1,d=1 specialization. Seven semantic searches of mathematical finding records and exact-phrase literature searches yielded no covering statement. Historical priority remains qualified by possibly unindexed work.

value.rationale: The rational boundary to recent irrational polynomial coprimality laws is a structurally natural problem. An exact numerator-independent finite-block law for every gcd value is substantially stronger than the known right-truncation coprimality table: it reveals the complete limiting distribution, a genuine 1/q mass escape on multiples of q, and quantitative convergence to the zeta density as q grows. These features motivate precisely the all-d invariant rather than an arbitrary narrow numerical slice; the finite checker is supporting evidence, not the value justification.
